requirements.reason: 最终答案逐项覆盖了题目要求的所有概念并给出硬件映射：grid（一次 kernel launch 的全部 thread block，可远大于 SM 数）、block（同一 grid 内 block 尺寸相同、单 SM 执行到完成、block 间无调度顺序保证）、thread（threadIdx/blockIdx 计算身份、以 warp lane 进入 SIMT 单元）、warp（32 线程一组、SIMT、分支时非激活 lane 被 mask、block 线程数宜为 32 倍数）、SM（含 local register file、unified data cache 物理承载 shared memory 与 L1、若干功能单元）、register（每线程私有、编译器分配、寄存器×线程数≤SM 可用寄存器否则不可 launch）、shared memory（SM 片上、按 block 分配、与 L1 共用可配置缓存）、global memory（GPU 侧 DRAM、device 视角命名、非必然全系统可访问）。这些关键主张均能逐字对应官方 Programming Model 正文：'All threads of a thread block are executed in a single SM'（block→SM）；'threads are organized into groups of 32 threads called warps'（warp=32/SIMT）；'the DRAM attached to the GPU is called global memory'（global=GPU DRAM）；'The register file stores thread local variables which are usually allocated by the compiler'（register 映射）；'The unified data cache provides the physical resources for shared memory and L1 cache'（shared/L1 映射）；'the total number of registers needed for each thread multiplied by the number of threads in the thread block must be less than or equal to the available registers in the SM'（寄存器约束）。答案还如实标注了证据边界（官方返回含 [...] 省略、未核实各架构精确容量），未编造数据。作为纯概念解释题，该回答完整且与官方来源一致。
